title: A release pipeline for an open-source library
subtitle: From the version freeze to the announcement, every step runs off the same checklist.

steps.name: Version freeze
steps.detail: Feature branches merged; only fixes accepted from here.

steps.name: Test matrix
steps.detail: Full runs across three operating systems and two LTS lines.

steps.name: RC preview
steps.detail: Candidate release published with a one-week community window.

steps.name: Signed build
steps.detail: Signed artifacts with reproducible-build hash verification.

steps.name: Ship
steps.detail: npm publish, Git tag, and mirror sync in one go.

steps.name: Announce
steps.detail: Release notes, migration guide, and community post go live together.

footer: Every step produces verifiable, reversible output; a failure stops the line instead of pushing through.
